lines: This plan covers 2 days, starting today.
You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Lubna eats.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Creamy Golden Dahl Bowls
dishes.title: Red lentil and sweet potato dahl with fresh spinach
dishes.method: Reheat the dahl portion in a pan until bubbling, then stir in the fresh spinach until just wilted. Serve warm.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting vegan meal that fits the small hob and meets the request for something that reheats well.

dishes.name: Zesty Chicken and Rice Plate
dishes.title: Lemon chicken thighs with basmati rice and green beans
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, rice, and vegetables together. Squeeze over the fresh lemon before serving.
dishes.why: A non-vegan plate for Roxane that uses the same cooking session but keeps her meal separate from the shared vegan pot.

dishes.name: Herby Golden Dahl
dishes.title: Red lentil and sweet potato dahl with fresh coriander
dishes.method: Reheat the dahl until piping hot. Top with a generous amount of roughly chopped coriander.
dishes.why: A warm element is essential for dinner, providing comfort after the day's work.

dishes.name: Post-Lift Chicken Fuel
dishes.title: Lemon chicken thighs with rice and sautéed peppers
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, rice, and vegetables. Season with an extra pinch of pepper for Ivar's post-gym meal.
dishes.why: A high-protein warm dinner for Ivar to support his Wednesday evening lifting session.

dishes.name: Zesty Chicken and Rice Plate
dishes.title: Lemon chicken thighs with basmati rice and green beans
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, rice, and vegetables together. Squeeze over the fresh lemon before serving.
dishes.why: A consistent, high-quality warm dinner for Roxane that respects her non-vegan preference.

dishes.name: Tomato Topped Golden Dahl
dishes.title: Red lentil and sweet potato dahl with fresh tomatoes
dishes.method: Reheat the dahl. Halve the cherry tomatoes and stir them in at the last second for a fresh burst of acidity.
dishes.why: The fresh tomatoes provide a 'loud' contrast to the creamy dahl for Thursday's lunch.

dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, rice, and vegetables together. Squeeze over the fresh lemon before serving.
dishes.why: A reliable lunch for Roxane that ensures she has a high-protein meal ready at work.

dishes.name: Crunchy Seeded Dahl
dishes.title: Red lentil and sweet potato dahl with sunflower seeds
dishes.method: Reheat the final portion of dahl. Scatter the sunflower seeds on top for texture and crunch.
dishes.why: Adding seeds creates a different eating experience from the same base preparation.

preparations.title: Red Lentil and Sweet Potato Dahl
preparations.method: Peel and cube sweet potatoes. In a large pot, sauté spices in oil, add potatoes and lentils. Pour in coconut milk and an equal amount of water. Simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are soft and potatoes are tender. Season with salt.

preparations.title: Pan-Seared Lemon Chicken
preparations.method: Season chicken with salt and oregano. Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Sear chicken for 6-8 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Let rest before boxing.

preparations.title: Steamed Basmati Rice
preparations.method: Rinse rice until water runs clear. Combine with 600ml water in a pot. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit covered for 5 minutes before fluffing.

preparations.title: Sautéed Green Beans and Peppers
preparations.method: Trim beans and slice peppers. Heat oil in a pan. Sauté vegetables for 8-10 minutes until tender-crisp and slightly charred. Season with salt.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the rice first. While it simmers, chop sweet potatoes and start the dahl in the second pot. Use the remaining hob space to sear the chicken thighs in a pan. Once chicken is done, set aside and use the same pan to sauté the green beans and peppers. Box all components into the named shares.
